objective: Research-release foundation for history-based seismic velocity models, with reproducible cases and honest independent evidence toward SOTA.
scope: Three versioned supported scenarios; parameterized physical histories, not separate laws
Installable thin Python API and CLI; safe standard NumPy/VTK exports and deterministic resumable batch studies
Exact globally indexed tiled output; same f64 material evaluation at every resolution
Finite-prior uncertainty and explicit observation-likelihood conditioning; synthetic verification, not field validation
Matched-comparison protocol and adapter, reproducibility and independent-solver checks where available
Documented current gaps, cross-platform CI configuration, local distributions and benchmark evidence
physicsPolicy: Shared laws/coefficients/tolerances unchanged. New core work limited to sampling windows and truthful capability metadata. Preserve frozen old outputs. No stress/flow/salt solver claim.
preregisteredChecks: Exact native/all-four-Wasm old-query equivalence against frozen baseline
Tiled/monolithic equality including nonbinary coordinate spacings and exact material interfaces; arbitrary points and out-of-range rejection
Export roundtrips, array ordering/units/precision, provenance tamper detection, resume and failing jobs
Parameter-prior determinism and analytic likelihood/effective-sample-size checks; no invented posterior coverage
Three-scenario seed cohort (fixed seeds 1001..1006), both coarse display and 10m research crop, fixed 10m material subdivision
Matched competitors must use equal domain, spacing, node/cell convention, work and hardware; unavailable results remain unavailable
Warmup plus three timing trials where affordable; report setup/evaluation/export separately and record memory boundaries
nonGoals: No superiority claim without matched evidence
No touching reserved FORCE holdout or observational arrays
No publishing or messaging independent labs
No silent license grant or author attribution
